== Summary ==
Identified: [[Emil Wallin]] (blonde bun, holding a print), [[Quirin Fürgut]] (black Red Fang tee; same face as [[:File:Quirin Fürgut 2023 European Championship.jpg]]), and [[Cedrik Vanderhaegen]] (black graphic tee, grey jeans; same face as [[:File:Cedrik Vanderhaegen 2023 European Championship.jpg]] and [[:File:2023 Naboo Regionals 19.jpg]]). The man in the white tee with his hands clasped is not named.

Players at the venue at the 2023 Naboo Regionals ("Foil Fest") weekend in Liverpool, UK, 2 June 2023, hosted by Team Wales.

* '''Event:''' [[2023 Regional Championships]]
* '''Date:''' 2 June 2023
* '''Date posted:''' 2023-05-31
* '''Identification:''' [[Emil Wallin]] (blonde bun, holding a print), [[Quirin Fürgut]] (black Red Fang tee; same face as [[:File:Quirin Fürgut 2023 European Championship.jpg]]), and [[Cedrik Vanderhaegen]] (black graphic tee, grey jeans; same face as [[:File:Cedrik Vanderhaegen 2023 European Championship.jpg]] and [[:File:2023 Naboo Regionals 19.jpg]]). The man in the white tee with his hands clasped is not named.
